#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
#include <cstring>
#include <climits>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

struct Half {
    ll match;
    ll value;
    Half() : match(0), value(0) {}
    Half(ll m, ll v) : match(m), value(v) {}
    bool operator<(const Half& o) const {
        return value < o.value;
    }
};

class F3 {
    vector<vector<ll>> ways;
    ll totalWays;
    ll bestDiff;
    ll ans;

    bool test(int mask, int i) const {
        return ((mask >> i) & 1) == 1;
    }

    ll choose(int n, int k) {
        if (n >= 0 && k >= 0 && k <= n) return ways[n][k];
        return 0;
    }

    void preCalc() {
        ways.assign(61, vector<ll>(61, 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < 61; i++) {
            ways[i][0] = ways[i][i] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                ways[i][j] = ways[i-1][j-1] + ways[i-1][j];
            }
        }
    }

    void update(const Half& a, const Half& b) {
        ll totalValue = a.value + b.value;
        ll diff = llabs(2 * totalValue - totalWays);
        ll delta = a.match * b.match;
        if (diff < bestDiff) {
            bestDiff = diff;
            ans = delta;
        } else if (diff == bestDiff) {
            ans += delta;
        }
    }

    vector<Half> compress(vector<Half>& arr) {
        sort(arr.begin(), arr.end());
        vector<Half> res;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < arr.size(); i++) {
            if (res.empty() || arr[i].value != res.back().value) {
                res.push_back(arr[i]);
            } else {
                res.back().match += arr[i].match;
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    ll solve(int r, int c, const string& s) {
        bestDiff = LLONG_MAX;
        ans = 0;

        ll maskA = 0;
        ll maskB = 0;
        int n = s.size();
        vector<vector<int>> cnt(n+1, vector<int>(2, 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            cnt[i+1][0] = cnt[i][0];
            cnt[i+1][1] = cnt[i][1];
            if (s[i] == 'A') {
                cnt[i+1][0]++;
                maskA |= (1LL << i);
            } else if (s[i] == 'B') {
                cnt[i+1][1]++;
                maskB |= (1LL << i);
            }
        }

        ll lastA = maskA >> ((2LL * r + c - 1) & 63);
        ll lastB = maskB >> ((2LL * r + c - 1) & 63);

        vector<vector<Half>> fst(c+2);
        vector<vector<Half>> snd(c+2);
        vector<int> sz(c+2, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= c+1; i++) {
            sz[i] = (int)ways[c+1][i];
            fst[i].resize(sz[i]);
            snd[i].resize(sz[i]);
        }

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << (c+1)); mask++) {
            int btc = __builtin_popcount(mask);
            int compBtc = c+1 - btc;
            int idx = --sz[btc];

            // first part
            {
                int samePref = 0;
                if (mask & 1) {
                    int x = mask;
                    while (x & 1) { samePref++; x >>= 1; }
                } else {
                    int x = mask;
                    while (!(x & 1) && samePref < c+1) { samePref++; x >>= 1; }
                }
                samePref = min(samePref, c+1);

                int totalA = r - 1 - cnt[2*r - 2 + samePref][0];
                int totalB = r - 1 - cnt[2*r - 2 + samePref][1];
                if ((mask & 1) == 0) {
                    totalA += samePref;
                } else {
                    totalB += samePref;
                }

                ll winsA = 0;
                int curA = 0, curB = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < c+1; i++) {
                    if (test(mask, i)) {
                        winsA += ways[r-1+curB][r-1] * choose(r-1+curA, r);
                        curB++;
                    } else {
                        curA++;
                    }
                }

                int exactMatch = 1;
                for (int i = samePref; i < c+1; i++) {
                    if (!test(mask, i) && s[2*r - 2 + i] == 'B') { exactMatch = 0; break; }
                    if (test(mask, i) && s[2*r - 2 + i] == 'A') { exactMatch = 0; break; }
                }

                fst[btc][idx] = Half(choose(totalA+totalB, totalA) * exactMatch, winsA);
            }

            // second part
            {
                int match = 1;
                if (((~mask) & lastB) != 0) match = 0;
                if ((mask & lastA) != 0) match = 0;

                ll winsA = 0;
                int curA = btc, curB = compBtc;
                for (int i = 0; i < c+1; i++) {
                    if (test(mask, i)) {
                        winsA += ways[r-1+curB][r-1] * choose(r-1+curA, r);
                        curB++;
                    } else {
                        curA++;
                    }
                }

                snd[btc][idx] = Half(match, winsA);
            }
        }

        totalWays = ways[r+c][r] * ways[r+c][r];
        ll halfTotal = totalWays / 2;

        for (int i = 0; i <= c+1; i++) {
            vector<Half> one = compress(fst[i]);
            vector<Half> two = compress(snd[c+1-i]);
            int ptr = (int)two.size() - 1;
            for (const Half& a : one) {
                while (ptr >= 0 && a.value + two[ptr].value > halfTotal) {
                    ptr--;
                }
                if (ptr >= 0) {
                    update(a, two[ptr]);
                }
                if (ptr + 1 < (int)two.size()) {
                    update(a, two[ptr+1]);
                }
            }
        }

        return ans;
    }

    void submit() {
        int r, c;
        string s;
        cin >> r >> c >> s;
        cout << solve(r, c, s) << endl;
    }

public:
    F3() {
        preCalc();
        submit();
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    F3 f;
    return 0;
}
